author: Lauren Martinez
title: Fox News viewers fume at 'pathetic, weak clown' Jesse Watters as he demands 'gratitude' - NewsBreak
text:
By Lauren Martinez ,
5 hours ago Fox News personality Jesse Watters has landed in hot water with some Fox News viewers once again, following a seemingly misogynistic rant on the Thursday, October 8, episode of The Five.
The Fox News personality, a staunch supporter of President Donald Trump , is no stranger to making controversial remarks, including some that have been called "sexist" in the past. But any previous backlash didn’t appear to bother the 48-year-old during the most recent broadcast of the evening talk show.
Just one day after a tense exchange with one of his co-hosts, who slammed him as “too rich” to talk about the Iran War , he faced a fresh wave of criticism from viewers for a controversial take on a story about the Trump administration saying they were trying to reach male voters.

• Gypsy Rose Blanchard leaves her dead partner's family 'disgusted' after he's found in 'grim' scene
When the topic was tossed toward Watters, he immediately launched into a tirade about discrimination, saying men are to thank for many achievements in the world.
“Now, if you’re trying to win men back, you know what you do?” he said. “You hire men. Stop hiring all of these other people. If I see a woman, and I see a man, and they’re equally qualified, I’m going with the guy. Is that discrimination?”
After remarking that not hiring the guy was also discrimination, he further continued his statement, saying, “Also, I would stop charging men with rape when they’re innocent. That’s a good start.”
He later made remarks that appeared to indicate there should be gratitude for things men have done.
“Also, honor the country. Young men fought and died for our independence. Young men signed the Declaration, the Constitution; they were like 23 years old,” he added. “Young men defeated the Indians, the Mexicans, the Germans, the Japanese. You’re welcome.”
“Young men were the pioneers that founded this great land. That invented everything that we’re using that you guys take for granted. So a little gratitude would go a long way.”
The remarks were met with swift backlash from viewers online.
“I don’t see how this pathetic, weak clown even pulls off his shtick. I can’t even get upset because he’s such an effeminate joke. He’s like the agitator in the third grade class that needs to get smacked again,” one person wrote on X, while another said, “Watters is a genuine waste of space.”
Others reminded him that what he had said about women was, in fact, discrimination.
“Wes it is Watters. I can’t stand you. You need to get the boot,” one person fumed, while another said, “uh, yeah. That’s basically the definition of discrimination.”
“Yes, it’s discrimination you dum dum,” a third wrote, while a fourth asked, “Why is he referring to woman as ‘other people?’”
“Such an idiot. The woman were in the factories making machinery and armor for world war ii,” another added, while a sixth snarked, “And this man has a makeup artist who does his face. A true mans man.”
36

Just one day after a tense exchange with one of his co-hosts, who slammed him as “too rich” to talk about the Iran War , he faced a fresh wave of criticism from viewers for a controversial take on a story about the Trump administration saying they were trying to reach male voters.
